summary.name: RemixMeme
summary.one_liner: RemixMeme is a web tool that turns one or two adult face photos into short 9:16 AI meme videos using a library of 488 viral-trend templates.
keywords: dog sings in car ai video
use_cases: Make a viral dance or trend clip from one photo for TikTok
Create a pet meme video of a dog or cat from a photo
Produce a vertical Reels video from a selfie without editing skills
Make a duet or two-person trend video from two photos
Create a holiday-themed AI video such as a Santa or Christmas trend
summary.what_it_does: The site offers a library of 488 meme templates, which you can browse free, and you pick one, upload 1–2 photos (JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 9 MB each, clear adult face), and get an approximately 15-second 9:16 MP4. Exports are stated to be watermark-free. Video generation costs credits (500 credits for a Ready for TikTok/Reels export; a 375-credit draft). The page says trending songs are not included, so users add a sound themselves in TikTok or Reels. Users must be 18+ with consent for everyone pictured, and the page says to label AI content when posting. Failed jobs have credits refunded automatically.
notable: 488 meme templates with 9:16 vertical output for TikTok and Reels
Watermark-free MP4 exports; trending sound added by the user afterward
Photos are deleted after rendering, per the stated privacy policy
Weekly, monthly, yearly and one-time credit pack options
caveats: Video generation requires credits or a paid plan or one-time pack; free welcome credits only cover images
Subscriptions are $4.99 for the first week then $12.99/week, or monthly/yearly tiers; trend songs are not included
Only adults (18+) with consent may appear; children, strangers and non-consensual deepfakes are prohibited
